title: gendn responsive support sidecar (responsive-support.json)
description: Git-tracked per-route mobile+desktop support record, merged into the route manifest as each entry's `support`. Default for every published page is `untested`. A class flips to `ok` ONLY after a real matrix pass (agent read the screenshots); the automated overflow scan marks `needs-review`, never `ok`. `unsupported` requires `evidence` that the API/hardware/runtime genuinely makes the class unavailable. `broken` = a supported class regressed (the gate fails on it for a touched page). Coverage is monotonic: an `ok` class must not silently drop back to `untested`.

evidence.description: Why the unsupported class is genuinely unavailable: API/hardware/runtime/model requirement.

method.description: How the record was set: `agent-matrix` (screenshots read), `auto-scan` (overflow scan only).
